dslRule:
<!id: reorder.method.modifiers.finalPublicToPublicFinal>
<!description: Reorder 'final public' to 'public final' for method declarations, according to Java code style conventions.>
<!severity: HINT>
final public $returnType $methodName($parameters$)
=>
public final $returnType $methodName($parameters$)
;;
summary: Reorder 'final public' to 'public final' for method declarations.
